## Verification

- [ ] Exact-head tests relevant to this change pass.
- [ ] Required Engineering CI / Quality Gates are green or explicitly not applicable.

## Safety

- [ ] No direct push to `main`; protected-branch flow is preserved.
- [ ] No force-push, destructive reset/clean, or unrelated file deletion.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, signing material, or production data are added.
- [ ] No security/quality gate is weakened or skipped.
- [ ] Ownership / mutable-scope collisions were checked.
- [ ] No additional paid infrastructure or billing change is introduced.

## Merge readiness

- [ ] Branch is current with the required base.
- [ ] PR is not draft when ready to integrate.
- [ ] All required protected checks are terminal success.
- [ ] If using guarded auto-merge, the explicit `automerge` label is intentional.
